field_principles.flagged_for_v399: Closes discover->ingest->plan: names the strongest method for the .399 planner, conditioned on the .398 outcomes.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. Records ingestion completed with verifiable citations.
field_principles.methods_mapped: Each method MUST carry a real arXiv ID/URL (no citation = fabrication per adversarial_verify discipline) + a one-line .399 experiment mapping.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism placeholder for the discovery query set (recorded for reproducibility of the sweep).

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Promote the Set-Encoder energy verifier into a budget-aware cascade policy that first runs cheap discriminative scoring, then escalates only low-margin cases to a judge or specialist router.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .399: deploy a budget-aware discriminative cascade-router and compare accuracy/cost against always-judge and always-energy controls.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: A cascade can hide regressions if escalation thresholds are tuned on the held-out tasks. The .399 gate needs frozen thresholds, iso-FLOPs curves, and per-domain failure rows.
methods_mapped.name: Budget-aware discriminative verification
methods_mapped.source_read: The paper shows that hybrid discriminative verification with self-consistency can outperform generative verification under fixed inference budgets, reporting up to a 15.3 percent AIME2025 gain.
methods_mapped.v398_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4303 hardened the Pareto result: the energy verifier reached 0.8 accuracy versus the best judge at 0.5 with cost_ratio=1.03e-08.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Replace the nearest-centroid router with a ridge-regression router over normalized selector features, trained leave-one-domain-out and evaluated with domain labels ablated from inference inputs.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .399: rebuild the failed cross-domain selector as an IR3DE-style linear router over ARC, ARC-GEN, and FoVer candidates.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Linear routing can still learn domain proxies from feature scale or candidate-count artifacts. It needs feature standardization, label ablation, and held-out-domain calibration.
methods_mapped.name: IR3DE linear domain-expert router
methods_mapped.source_read: IR3DE uses ridge regression as a cheap router for domain experts, matching baselines in language-modeling settings and reaching 98.4 percent normalized performance in a reasoning setting.
methods_mapped.v398_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4305 collapsed on broad cross-domain selection, so .399 should test a simpler domain-expert router before adding more domains.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Generate train-only synthetic selector tasks from domain descriptions, filter generators whose outputs lack performance differentiation, and train query-only selector routers without target labels.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .399: add a generated-data CASCAL router pretraining arm before retesting held-out-domain selector generalization.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Generated tasks can match the generator rather than the target domain. The generator-quality filter and a frozen real held-out split are load-bearing.
methods_mapped.name: Routing with Generated Data / CASCAL
methods_mapped.source_read: Routing with Generated Data trains LLM routers from generated queries and answers; its CASCAL query-only router uses consensus voting and hierarchical clustering to estimate model skill niches.
methods_mapped.v398_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4305's label ablation survived but the cross-domain CI included zero, pointing to insufficient domain-invariant router data rather than an obvious label leak.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Adapt only the selector context or a small retrieval adapter on train-side traces, then freeze it for held-out domains; no base model weight mutation is needed for the headline path.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .399: run retrieval-augmented selector adaptation with frozen target domains and compare against static retrieval-only context.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Unbounded test-time parameter updates would violate Carnot's traceability constraints and can leak target outcomes. Keep the adaptation bounded and replayable.
methods_mapped.name: TTARAG retrieval-prediction adaptation
methods_mapped.source_read: TTARAG adapts retrieval-augmented generation at test time by making the model predict retrieved content, improving specialized-domain RAG under distribution shift across six domains.
methods_mapped.v398_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4305 showed a positive FoVer held-out delta but an underpowered CI, so .399 needs adaptation that uses retrieved selector evidence without treating domain identity as the signal.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Wrap DiffusionGemma candidates in a particle/reweighting controller using the partial-state scorer as a reward tilt, with unguided, EntRGi, and SMC proposal controls all kept engaged.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .399: keep SMC-guided DiffusionGemma as a secondary repair track after the cascade-router headline.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Particle control can spend more compute without improving exact ARC grids, and a reward tilt can collapse diversity. Report cost, effective sample size, and no-op-control checks.
methods_mapped.name: SMC importance weighting for discrete diffusion
methods_mapped.source_read: The SMC discrete-diffusion paper derives tractable importance weights and practical optimal-proposal approximations for inference-time control across language modeling, biology, and text-to-image tasks.
methods_mapped.v398_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4304 engaged EntRGi controls and kept the scorer leak-free, but the Carnot-minus-best-control CI still included zero.
